What's Inside

Key Herbal Ingredients

Amla

Indian gooseberry, traditionally used to strengthen roots and promote hair growth.

Hibiscus

Known for preventing hair fall and adding natural shine and softness.

Bhringraj

A revered Ayurvedic herb, traditionally used to nourish hair and reduce premature greying.

Brahmi

Traditionally valued for calming the scalp and supporting stronger, thicker-feeling hair.

Neem

Known for its purifying properties, helping keep the scalp clean and balanced.

Curry Leaves

A traditional remedy believed to nourish roots and add natural pigment and shine.

Fenugreek

Rich in nutrients, traditionally used to strengthen hair and reduce breakage.

Coconut Oil Base

Deeply conditions from root to tip and adds lasting natural luster.

Rosemary Extract

Traditionally used to invigorate the scalp and support healthy-looking hair.
